purpose: Authoritative source registry for AssetShakti multi-auction intelligence.

sources.name: BAANKNET — Bank Assets Auction Network
sources.evidenceBasis: Official IBBI sale notices identify BAANKNET as the approved e-auction platform and state that complete auction documents are uploaded there; exact pilot-lot certification remains separate.

mandatoryControls: Only direct auction platforms and authoritative auction operators are eligible source truth.
Preserve provider, source URL, auction ID and exact lot ID.
Exact auction and lot identity is a hard gate; missing IDs fail closed and cannot enter decision evidence.
Never merge lots merely because title, location or debtor appears similar.
Preserve auction mechanism; do not assume every source is a simple English auction.
Hash acquired documents and bind hashes to the exact source record/version.
Acquisition or discovery never equals verification.
Reserve price is not independent market valuation.
Decision evidence requires existing AssetShakti verification, reconciliation and Shakti gates.
AssetShakti does not execute bids, payments or transaction commitments.
Do not bypass authentication, CAPTCHA, robots controls, paywalls or other access restrictions.
Where machine-readable acquisition is unavailable, use controlled authorised evidence intake.
Production certification requires the provider certification gate and remains OFF until all applicable gates pass.
